english:
John 18:28. "Then they led Jesus..." to [chapter] 19:16: "...that He might be crucified."
Song: "Ch'handurzhiāl" (Unenduring). Litany: "Let us ask..." "Save [us]." Prayer: "To Your almighty and wondrous betrayal..."

And then, placing the holy Cross and the Gospel upon the lectern, and the priests forming a circle, the bishop or the senior priest shall cense, and the others shall begin the Hymn Tone 2 [Pyts]: "We bow down before Your Cross, O Christ, and we magnify Your holy betrayal, and we glorify Your holy sufferings. Come, O faithful, let us bow down to Christ our God, because by means of His Cross He granted gifts to the world. Holy God, holy and mighty, holy and immortal, who wast betrayed for us, have mercy on us" — repeating this three times.
And then: "Glory to Your holy Cross, Alleluia; to Your holy betrayal, Alleluia; to Your sufferings, Alleluia." "It was signed..." etc. "Glory to Your holy Cross..." and so on likewise. "Glory and worship to the Father and the Son..." etc. "Glory to Your holy Cross..." and so on likewise.
Then: "The life-giving Cross which became salvation for us." Afterward, Litany: "By this holy Cross..." Prayer: "Keep us..."
And then they shall read the Testament of Great Friday, which is concerning the Crucifixion of Christ. On this day during the daytime, there is no command to kneel, until the evening hour.
And at the third hour of the day, they shall come and say the three "Have mercy on me" [psalms] together with the great Litanies and Prayers. Afterward: "For the souls of those who are asleep."

Then at the sixth hour, they shall assemble at the door of the church, and they shall perform the Order of the Crucifixion.
They shall begin to read the eight alternating Psalms, and the sixteen scriptural readings, and the four Gospel chapters. The first reading belongs to the class of the disciples.
First Psalm 34 [35] (say in full): "False witnesses rose up against me..." alternating with: "Judge, O Lord..."
Prophet Zechariah 11:11: "And the Canaanites knew..." to verse 14: "...and between Israel."
Epistle Galatians 6:14: "But far be it from me to glory..." to verse 18: "...brethren. Amen."
Prayer along with psalmody: "Let us beseech the Lord," repeat three times. Afterward: "Again and again in peace..." "Blessing and glory to the Father and..."

Second Psalm 37 [38] (say in full): "I am ready for scourges..." alternating with: "O Lord, do not rebuke me in Your wrath..."
Prophet Isaiah 3:9: "For which reason they were humbled..." to verse 15: "...the Lord of hosts."
Epistle Philippians 2:5: "Let this mind be in you..." to verse 11: "...to the glory of God the Father."
Prayer along with psalmody as written above.

Third Psalm 40 [41] (say in full): "He entered to see vanity..." alternating with: "Blessed is he who considers..."
Prophet Isaiah 50:4: "The Lord God gives me..." to verse 9: "...who is he that shall afflict me?"
Epistle Romans 5:6: "For while we were still weak..." to verse 11: "...we have now received reconciliation."

[Fourth Psalm 21 [22] (say in full): "They divided my garments..." alternating with: "My God, my God, look upon me..."
Prophet Amos 8:9: "And it shall come to pass on that day..." to verse 12: "...and they shall not find it."
Epistle 1 Corinthians 1:18: "For the word of the Cross..." to verse 31: "...let him boast in the Lord."

Fifth Psalm 30 [31] (say in full): "Into Your hands I commend..." alternating with: "In You, O Lord, have I hoped..."
Prophet Isaiah 52:13: "Behold, My servant shall understand..." to [chapter] 53:12: "...He was betrayed."
Epistle Hebrews 2:11: "For He who sanctifies..." to verse 18: "...to help [those who are tempted]."
And then they shall begin the Song: "Noroghogh tiyezerats" (Renovator of the universe).
Gospel Matthew 27:1: "When morning came..." to verse 56: "...the sons of Zebedee." This Gospel reading belongs to the class of the senior priests.

Sixth Psalm 68 [69] (say in full): "They gave me gall for my food..." alternating with: "Save me, O God..."
Prophet Isaiah 63:1: "Who is this that comes..." to verse 6: "...their strength to the earth."
Epistle Hebrews 9:11: "But Christ having come..." to verse 28: "...through faith unto salvation."
Song: "Etun ympel" (They gave to drink).
Gospel Mark 15:1: "And immediately in the morning..." to verse 41: "...who had come up with Him to Jerusalem."
